heading: Funding

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: For the purpose of making allotments under section 300ee–11(a) of this title, there are authorized to be appropriated $165,000,000 for fiscal year 1989 and such sums as may be necessary for each of the fiscal years 1990 and 1991.

tree.heading: Availability to States
tree.text: Any amounts paid to a State under section 300ee–11(a) of this title shall remain available to the State until the expiration of the 1-year period beginning on the date on which the State receives such amounts.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 2514 of act July 1, 1944, was successively renumbered by subsequent acts, see section 238m of this title.
